classification.difficultyReason: Find stationary points of a cubic PDF, reject the point outside the domain and compare the remaining maximum with both endpoints.

content.prompt: Find the mode of $f(x)=\dfrac{2(2x^3-33x^2+168x+3)}{2105}$ defined in the interval $0\le x\le5$.

answer.worked:
Differentiate and solve $f'(x)=0$:

$$\begin{align*}f'(x)&=\frac{2(6x^2-66x+168)}{2105}\\0&=\frac{12}{2105}(x^2-11x+28)\\x^2-11x+28&=0\\(x-4)(x-7)&=0\\x&=4\text{ or }7.\end{align*}$$

Only $x=4$ lies in $[0,5]$.

$$\begin{align*}f''(x)&=\frac{12(2x-11)}{2105}\\f''(4)&=-\frac{36}{2105}<0.\end{align*}$$

Thus $x=4$ is a local maximum. Check the function values at this point and the boundaries:

$$f(0)=\frac{6}{2105},\qquad f(4)=\frac{110}{421}\approx0.26,\qquad f(5)=\frac{536}{2105}\approx0.25.$$

The greatest value occurs at $x=4$, so the mode is $4$.
